title: PCP shared definitions
description: Types shared by every PCP frame: ids, timestamps, users, rooms, scopes, message content elements, media and sticker references, members. Objects allow unknown properties so that additive protocol changes never break older validators (see spec/PCP.md, Versioning).

Id.description: Opaque identifier. Frame ids, message ids, session ids, blob ids. ULIDs recommended for frame ids.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC with millisecond precision recommended, e.g. 2026-10-05T18:04:11.532Z.

TypeName.description: Event or action type. Dotted lowercase segments. Vendor extensions use the x.<platform>. prefix.

Platform.description: Platform name: camfrog, discord, twitch, telegram, patv, ...

Seq.description: Per-session sequence number assigned by the connector to every event and result frame. Starts at 1, strictly increasing by 1.

Ext.description: Platform-specific extras, keyed by platform name. Modules that do not know a key ignore it. Never required for correct behaviour.

UserRef.description: A user on one platform. Global identity key is (scope.platform, id). The identity service maps that pair to a PATV account.

id.description: Stable external id. Camfrog: the login lowercased. Discord: snowflake. Twitch: numeric user id.

login.description: Account/login name as the platform spells it (Camfrog login, Discord username, Twitch login). Used for platform commands such as /kick.

display.description: Human-facing display name, markup stripped. May differ from login and may change at any time; never use it as a key.

display_raw.description: Display name exactly as the platform delivered it, including markup (Camfrog ..).

is_self.description: True when this is the connector's own bot account.

is_bot.description: True when the platform or connector knows this is an automated account (room bots).

RoomRef.description: A room, channel, thread or DM conversation.

id.description: Stable external id. Camfrog: the room id from the JOIN packet (not the window title). Discord: channel snowflake. Twitch: broadcaster user id.

parent_id.description: Parent channel of a thread, or category of a channel.

RoomTarget.description: A room named by id and/or display name (used by room.join, where the caller may only know the display name).

GuildRef.description: A server/workspace that contains rooms (Discord guild). Absent on platforms without one.

Scope.description: Where something happens. platform is always present. room is absent only for connector-wide events (presence, inbox, status).

MediaRef.description: Reference to binary media. Bytes never travel inside a PCP frame except tiny inline data. 'blob' names an object in the runtime's blob store (uploaded by the connector before the frame is sent, see spec/PCP.md, Media); 'url' is any fetchable location.

data.description: Inline base64, at most 64 KiB decoded (87384 chars).

Element.description: One message content element (Satori-style). Unknown element types are allowed and must carry a plain-text fallback in 'text' when they have a textual rendering.

MemberGroup.description: Where a member sits in the room's list. Camfrog: members (on cam) / lurkers (off cam) / viewing. Platforms without groups omit it.

Text.description: Plain text. Connectors split over-long outbound text according to limits.message_max_chars.
